research_policy.claim_policy: Claims stop at the strongest evidence actually carried by this repository; negative evidence and unresolved remainder are retained.
research_policy.selection_policy: Selection is bounded, task-local, and minimal-necessity; unselected possibilities are not treated as false and selection does not imply global optimality.
research_policy.knowledge_decay: Treat evidence age, accessibility, dependency drift, and changed external facts as active inputs when they can alter the current claim.
research_policy.historical_checkpoint_policy: Do not rewrite verified predecessors merely to conform to newer lessons.
